title: Matchsticks to Square
summary: Decide whether all sticks can be assigned to four sides of equal total length.

contractDetails.output-checking: Compare boolean feasibility of assigning every position to one of four equal-sum sides.

statement: Decide whether all sticks can be assigned to four sides of equal total length. Use every stick exactly once and keep each stick intact.

examples.explanation: Three sides use one length-3 stick each, and the last uses 1+2.
One stick cannot form four equal sides.
The required side length is 3, which these sticks cannot produce.

hints: Conceptual: The sum of all lengths determines the required side length.
Directional: Place long sticks first to discover impossible placements early.
Implementation: Backtrack over sides whose remaining space is large enough. Skip equivalent choices with the same current side total.
complexityAnalysis: O(4^n) worst-case search time and O(n) auxiliary space, including sorted working storage.
